name: scrollcontrol
description: Your life. Your scroll. Your control.

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && node bundle-content.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist/popup',{recursive:true});try{fs.renameSync('dist/src/popup/index.html','dist/popup/index.html')}catch(e){}try{fs.rmSync('dist/src',{recursive:true})}catch(e){}fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json','dist/manifest.json');try{fs.cpSync('public/icons','dist/icons',{recursive:true})}catch(e){}"
